items.description: The report does not give a numeric definition of 'huge numbers of shares' or 'tiny (or zero) assets', so the share-burn magnitude relation is represented only by a grounded Boolean outcome.
The report does not define the near-zero denominator value or the fulfilment math that corrupts share-price accounting.

The report does not state the fulfilment math relation between the near-zero denominator and the resulting share price, so the corrupted share-price value cannot be bound numerically; only the qualitative corruption Boolean is representable.
